/bin/bash -c "python3 - <<'PY'
from Bio import pairwise2
human=''
chimp=''
alns=pairwise2.align.globalms(human,chimp,2,-1,-5,-2)
a=alns[0]
print('score',a.score)
print(a.seqA)
print(a.seqB)
print('differences',sum(x"'!=y for x,y in zip(a.seqA,a.seqB)),'"'gaps',a.seqA.count('-')+a.seqB.count('-'))
PY"
